# Provinces are eligible expedition targets if neither you nor your subjects own them, and you don't have a truce or alliance with the owner.
MEC_Expeditions_eligible_province_trigger = {
	AND = {
		NOT = {
			country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
		}
		NOT = {
			owner = {
				ROOT = {
					truce_with = PREV
				}
			}
		}
		NOT = {
			owner = {
				overlord_of = ROOT
			}
		}
		NOT = {
			owner = {
				OR = {
					alliance_with = ROOT
					overlord = {
						alliance_with = ROOT
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# AI Expedition Goals (see goals_list in MEC-Expeditions_Writer.py)
############################################################################################################

# North African foothold (Ceuta, Melilla)
MEC_Expeditions_goal_north_africa_done_trigger = {
	num_of_provinces_owned_or_owned_by_non_sovereign_subjects_with = {
		value = 1
		OR = { province_group = expedition_provs.northwest_africa }
	}
}
MEC_Expeditions_goal_north_africa_valid_trigger = {
	NOT = { MEC_Expeditions_goal_north_africa_done_trigger = yes }
	OR = { # Not blocked: some target province is likely to be gained (>= 40% expedition success), or no target is available yet
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_northwest_africa
		NOT = { # No target available yet
			OR = {
				MEC_Expeditions_available_northwest_africa_trigger = yes
			}
		}
	}
	NOT = { # Not every target failed recently (NOT alone would be NOR, hence the AND)
		AND = {
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_northwest_africa
		}
	}
	OR = { # A route expedition is available and likely to succeed
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_northwest_africa
	}
}

# West African trading posts (Elmina, Goree)
MEC_Expeditions_goal_west_african_posts_done_trigger = {
	num_of_provinces_owned_or_owned_by_non_sovereign_subjects_with = {
		value = 1
		OR = { province_group = expedition_provs.west_africa province_group = expedition_provs.gulf_of_guinea }
	}
}
MEC_Expeditions_goal_west_african_posts_valid_trigger = {
	NOT = { MEC_Expeditions_goal_west_african_posts_done_trigger = yes }
	OR = { # Not blocked: some target province is likely to be gained (>= 40% expedition success), or no target is available yet
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_west_africa
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_gulf_of_guinea
		NOT = { # No target available yet
			OR = {
				MEC_Expeditions_available_west_africa_trigger = yes
				MEC_Expeditions_available_gulf_of_guinea_trigger = yes
			}
		}
	}
	NOT = { # Not every target failed recently (NOT alone would be NOR, hence the AND)
		AND = {
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_west_africa
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_gulf_of_guinea
		}
	}
	OR = { # A route expedition is available and likely to succeed
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_west_africa
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_gulf_of_guinea
	}
}

# Reach India (Goa, Surat, Pondicherry, Tranquebar)
MEC_Expeditions_goal_india_done_trigger = {
	num_of_provinces_owned_or_owned_by_non_sovereign_subjects_with = {
		value = 1
		OR = { province_group = expedition_provs.western_india province_group = expedition_provs.southern_india province_group = expedition_provs.eastern_india }
	}
}
MEC_Expeditions_goal_india_valid_trigger = {
	NOT = { MEC_Expeditions_goal_india_done_trigger = yes }
	OR = { # Not blocked: some target province is likely to be gained (>= 40% expedition success), or no target is available yet
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_western_india
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_southern_india
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_eastern_india
		NOT = { # No target available yet
			OR = {
				MEC_Expeditions_available_western_india_trigger = yes
				MEC_Expeditions_available_southern_india_trigger = yes
				MEC_Expeditions_available_eastern_india_trigger = yes
			}
		}
	}
	NOT = { # Not every target failed recently (NOT alone would be NOR, hence the AND)
		AND = {
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_western_india
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_southern_india
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_eastern_india
		}
	}
	OR = { # A route expedition is available and likely to succeed
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_western_india
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_southern_india
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_eastern_india
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_east_africa
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_indian_ocean
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_south_africa
	}
}

# Colonize the Philippines (Manila)

}

# Settle Brazil
MEC_Expeditions_goal_brazil_done_trigger = {
	OR = {
		any_subject_country = {
			is_colonial_nation = yes
			num_of_owned_provinces_with = {
				value = 3
				OR = { province_group = expedition_provs.north_brazil province_group = expedition_provs.south_brazil }
			}
		}
		num_of_provinces_owned_or_owned_by_non_sovereign_subjects_with = {
			value = 5
			OR = { province_group = expedition_provs.north_brazil province_group = expedition_provs.south_brazil }
		}
	}
}
MEC_Expeditions_goal_brazil_valid_trigger = {
	NOT = { MEC_Expeditions_goal_brazil_done_trigger = yes }
	OR = { # Not blocked: some target province is likely to be gained (>= 40% expedition success), or no target is available yet
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_north_brazil
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_south_brazil
		NOT = { # No target available yet
			OR = {
				MEC_Expeditions_available_north_brazil_trigger = yes
				MEC_Expeditions_available_south_brazil_trigger = yes
			}
		}
	}
	NOT = { # Not every target failed recently (NOT alone would be NOR, hence the AND)
		AND = {
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_north_brazil
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_south_brazil
		}
	}
	OR = { # A route expedition is available and likely to succeed
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_north_brazil
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_south_brazil
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_west_africa
	}
}

				value = 3
				OR = { province_group = expedition_provs.cuba province_group = expedition_provs.hispaniola province_group = expedition_provs.caribbean }
			}
		}
		num_of_provinces_owned_or_owned_by_non_sovereign_subjects_with = {
			value = 5
			OR = { province_group = expedition_provs.cuba province_group = expedition_provs.hispaniola province_group = expedition_provs.caribbean }
		}
	}
}

		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_hispaniola

				MEC_Expeditions_available_hispaniola_trigger = yes
				MEC_Expeditions_available_caribbean_trigger = yes
			}

			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_hispaniola
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_caribbean

	OR = { # A route expedition is available and likely to succeed
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_cuba
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_hispaniola

MEC_Expeditions_goal_pacific_valid_trigger = {
	NOT = { MEC_Expeditions_goal_pacific_done_trigger = yes }
	OR = { # Not blocked: some target province is likely to be gained (>= 40% expedition success), or no target is available yet
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_pacific_central_america
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_pacific_mexico
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_peru
		NOT = { # No target available yet
			OR = {
				MEC_Expeditions_available_pacific_central_america_trigger = yes
				MEC_Expeditions_available_pacific_mexico_trigger = yes
				MEC_Expeditions_available_peru_trigger = yes
			}
		}
	}
	NOT = { # Not every target failed recently (NOT alone would be NOR, hence the AND)
		AND = {
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_pacific_central_america
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_pacific_mexico
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_peru
		}
	}
	OR = { # A route expedition is available and likely to succeed
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_pacific_central_america
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_pacific_mexico
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_peru
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_atlantic_mexico
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_atlantic_colombia
	}
}

# Conquer the Inca
MEC_Expeditions_goal_inca_done_trigger = {
	num_of_provinces_owned_or_owned_by_non_sovereign_subjects_with = {
		value = 3
		OR = { province_group = expedition_provs.peru }
	}
}
MEC_Expeditions_goal_inca_valid_trigger = {
	NOT = { MEC_Expeditions_goal_inca_done_trigger = yes }
	OR = { # Not blocked: some target province is likely to be gained (>= 40% expedition success), or no target is available yet
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_peru
		NOT = { # No target available yet
			OR = {
				MEC_Expeditions_available_peru_trigger = yes
			}
		}
	}
	NOT = { # Not every target failed recently (NOT alone would be NOR, hence the AND)
		AND = {
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_peru
		}
	}
	OR = { # A route expedition is available and likely to succeed
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_peru
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_pacific_central_america
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_atlantic_colombia
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_chile
	}
}

# Colonize East-North America
MEC_Expeditions_goal_east_north_america_done_trigger = {
	num_of_provinces_owned_or_owned_by_non_sovereign_subjects_with = {
		value = 10
		OR = { province_group = expedition_provs.eastern_america province_group = expedition_provs.southeastern_america province_group = expedition_provs.canada }
	}
}
MEC_Expeditions_goal_east_north_america_valid_trigger = {
	NOT = { MEC_Expeditions_goal_east_north_america_done_trigger = yes }
	OR = { # Not blocked: some target province is likely to be gained (>= 40% expedition success), or no target is available yet
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_eastern_america
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_southeastern_america
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_canada
		NOT = { # No target available yet
			OR = {
				MEC_Expeditions_available_eastern_america_trigger = yes
				MEC_Expeditions_available_southeastern_america_trigger = yes
				MEC_Expeditions_available_canada_trigger = yes
			}
		}
	}
	NOT = { # Not every target failed recently (NOT alone would be NOR, hence the AND)
		AND = {
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_eastern_america
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_southeastern_america
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_canada
		}
	}
	OR = { # A route expedition is available and likely to succeed
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_eastern_america
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_southeastern_america
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_canada
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_north_atlantic
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_gulf_of_mexico
	}
}

# Reach West-North America (California, Alaska)
MEC_Expeditions_goal_reach_west_north_america_done_trigger = {
	num_of_provinces_owned_or_owned_by_non_sovereign_subjects_with = {
		value = 1
		OR = { province_group = expedition_provs.california province_group = expedition_provs.alaska }
	}
}
MEC_Expeditions_goal_reach_west_north_america_valid_trigger = {
	NOT = { MEC_Expeditions_goal_reach_west_north_america_done_trigger = yes }
	OR = { # Not blocked: some target province is likely to be gained (>= 40% expedition success), or no target is available yet
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_california
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_alaska
		NOT = { # No target available yet
			OR = {
				MEC_Expeditions_available_california_trigger = yes
				MEC_Expeditions_available_alaska_trigger = yes
			}
		}
	}
	NOT = { # Not every target failed recently (NOT alone would be NOR, hence the AND)
		AND = {
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_california
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_alaska
		}
	}
	OR = { # A route expedition is available and likely to succeed
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_california
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_alaska
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_pacific_mexico
	}
}

# Colonize West-North America
MEC_Expeditions_goal_west_north_america_done_trigger = {
	OR = {
		any_subject_country = {
			is_colonial_nation = yes
			num_of_owned_provinces_with = {
				value = 3
				OR = { province_group = expedition_provs.california province_group = expedition_provs.alaska }
			}
		}
		num_of_provinces_owned_or_owned_by_non_sovereign_subjects_with = {
			value = 5
			OR = { province_group = expedition_provs.california province_group = expedition_provs.alaska }
		}
	}
}
MEC_Expeditions_goal_west_north_america_valid_trigger = {
	NOT = { MEC_Expeditions_goal_west_north_america_done_trigger = yes }
	OR = { # Not blocked: some target province is likely to be gained (>= 40% expedition success), or no target is available yet
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_california
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_alaska
		NOT = { # No target available yet
			OR = {
				MEC_Expeditions_available_california_trigger = yes
				MEC_Expeditions_available_alaska_trigger = yes
			}
		}
	}
	NOT = { # Not every target failed recently (NOT alone would be NOR, hence the AND)
		AND = {
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_california
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_alaska
		}
	}
	OR = { # A route expedition is available and likely to succeed
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_california
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_alaska
	}
}

# Get a Colonial Nation
MEC_Expeditions_goal_colonial_nation_done_trigger = {
	any_subject_country = { is_colonial_nation = yes }
}
MEC_Expeditions_goal_colonial_nation_valid_trigger = {
	NOT = { MEC_Expeditions_goal_colonial_nation_done_trigger = yes }
	NOT = { # Not every target failed recently (NOT alone would be NOR, hence the AND)
		AND = {
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_south_africa
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_australia
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_cuba
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_hispaniola
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_atlantic_colombia
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_guyana
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_atlantic_mexico
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_north_brazil
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_south_brazil
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_gulf_of_mexico
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_southeastern_america
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_eastern_america
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_canada
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_hudson_bay
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_la_plata
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_california
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_alaska
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_pacific_mexico
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_pacific_central_america
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_peru
			has_country_modifier = MEC_Modifier_Expedition_Failed_chile
		}
	}
	OR = { # A route expedition is available and likely to succeed
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_south_africa
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_australia
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_cuba
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_hispaniola
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_atlantic_colombia
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_guyana
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_atlantic_mexico
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_north_brazil
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_south_brazil
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_gulf_of_mexico
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_southeastern_america
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_eastern_america
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_canada
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_hudson_bay
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_la_plata
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_california
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_alaska
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_pacific_mexico
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_pacific_central_america
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_peru
		has_country_flag = MEC_Expeditions_gainable_chile
	}
}
